# [Jetson Nano: Visualized Stereo Audio Using JUCE FFT Demo 6.0.7 on L4T R32.5.1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eDxMCA4IwG8)

**Visibility**: Public
**Uploaded by**: [Alan Mikhak](http://www.youtube.com/@alanmikhak)
**Uploaded at**: 2021-06-01T22:50:59-07:00
**Published at**: 2021-06-01T22:50:59-07:00
**Length**: 03:44
**Views**: 1552
**Likes**: 14
**Category**: Science & Technology

## Description

```
This video shows I added visualization of stereo audio signal captured from a USB microphone along with FFT transform and spectrogram to my OpenCV time exposure application. I used the JUCE audio framework FFT Demo 6.0.7 as a template. The sample program is shown running on my Nvidia Jetson Nano DevKit Model A02. The board has 4GB of RAM and 128GB micro-SD card. It runs Nvidia Linux for Tegra (L4T) Release 32 Revision 5.1 (R32.5.1) on Linux kernel 4.9.201-tegra and Ubuntu 18.04.5 LTS (bionic) for aarch64.

JUCE Framework GitHub Repo:
https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE
git commit hash: 99112cf71f0cc3aafa4622b62cf81f2b7df38f0b

JUCE Simple FFT example:
https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE/blob/master/examples/Audio/SimpleFFTDemo.h

Jetson Nano: Added Audio Spectrogram Using JUCE FFT Demo 6.0.7:
https://youtu.be/B4fUgP3E6a0

Raspberry Pi 4: Explored JUCE FFT Demo 6.0.7 on Raspbian 10 (buster)
https://youtu.be/LVFT6rOPjr8

Sabrent USB External Stereo Sound Adapter
https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00IRVQ0F8

VidPro XM-55 Condenser Shotgun Mic
https://www.newegg.com/vidpro-xm-55-condenser-microphones/p/0UK-0054-00001
```
